So if you change the mesh, please use `reshard` to reshard the existing array onto the new mesh.

issue.body:
### Description

To simplify our test runners I'm trying to dynamically change the mesh of some replicated arrays , but I see an error that feels like it might be a jax bug, but I might be wrong.

In short, if you `Jax.device_put()` an array from a sharding to another sharding where the mesh has changed, it seem that the result maintains internally (in the aval) the old sharding.

```python
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import lax
from jax.sharding import Mesh, NamedSharding, PartitionSpec, AxisType

jax.config.update("jax_num_cpu_devices", 4)

mesh = jax.make_mesh((4,), axis_names=('s',), axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,))
jax.sharding.set_mesh(mesh)

array = jnp.zeros(8)
print("array.sharding.mesh         :", array.sharding.mesh)
print("typeof(array).sharding.mesh :", jax.typeof(array).sharding.mesh)

mesh_null = jax.make_mesh((), ())
jax.sharding.set_mesh(mesh_null)

array_new = jnp.zeros(8)
array = jax.device_put(array, device=array_new.sharding)

@jax.jit
def myfun(x):
	return x+1

myfun(array_new) # works
myfun(array) # fails
```

raises error
```python
File ~/Nextcloud/Codes/Python/netket/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/jax/_src/interpreters/pxla.py:2317, in lower_sharding_computation(closed_jaxpr, api_name, fun_name, in_shardings, out_shardings, in_layouts, out_layouts, donated_invars, keep_unused, context_mesh, compiler_options_kvs, lowering_platforms, lowering_parameters, pgle_profiler)
   2313 for a in global_out_avals:
   2314   if (a is not core.abstract_token and not a.sharding.mesh.empty and
   2315       a.sharding.mesh.are_all_axes_explicit and
   2316       len(device_assignment) != a.sharding.mesh.size):
-> 2317     raise ValueError(
   2318         f"Length of device assignment {len(device_assignment)} is not equal"
   2319         f" to the size of the mesh {a.sharding.mesh.size} of aval"
   2320         f" {a.str_short(True, True)}. Please enter your `jit` into a mesh"
   2321         " context via `jax.set_mesh`.")
   2323 # TODO(parkers): One _raw_platform has been unified with platform,
   2324 # change this back to just read platform.
   2325 platforms = lowering_platforms or (
   2326     getattr(backend, "_raw_platform", backend.platform),)

ValueError: Length of device assignment 1 is not equal to the size of the mesh 4 of aval f32[8]({Explicit: ('s',)}). Please enter your `jit` into a mesh context via `jax.set_mesh`.
```

one thing that seems wrong is that after using `jax.device_put` I can observe
```python
In [12]: array.sharding
Out[12]: SingleDeviceSharding(device=CpuDevice(id=0), memory_kind=device)

In [13]: array.aval.sharding
Out[13]: NamedSharding(mesh=AbstractMesh('s': 4, axis_types=(Explicit,), device_kind=cpu, num_tpu_cores=0), spec=PartitionSpec(None,))
```

### System info (python version, jaxlib version, accelerator, etc.)

jax 0.7.1

issue.body: Fix device_put's abstract_eval to return the correct sharding on the type when the sharding passed to it changes. Fixes https://github.com/jax-ml/jax/issues/31793
